note: Mineral County NV zones Hawthorne, Mina, Luning and Walker Lake under Title 17 (A-1 to M-3), but the 2022 Master Plan says zoning maps are recorded on paper at the County Recorder's office. No county or city zoning district polygon layer is published as an ArcGIS service or file. Mineral County has no incorporated cities (Hawthorne is a CDP). The statewide Nevada parcel layer has no zoning field, and Regrid zoning is about 2% populated. ArcGIS Hub and Online searches for Mineral County zoning returned nothing usable.
